name: Stripe Payment Agent
description: Detection rules + Cedar policy templates for AI agents that initiate Stripe charges, refunds, or transfers. Enforces per-transaction caps, recipient allowlists, mandate validation, and human-in-loop above thresholds.

demo_agents.name: stripe-demo
demo_agents.description: Throwaway demo for learning. NOT for production. Your real payment agent must use TEST keys in dev and have an explicit recipient allowlist with your verified vendors only.

policy_templates.description: Cap individual transaction amount. Defaults to your safest single-tx limit.
policy_templates.cedar_template: forbid(principal, action == Action::"payment.transaction.create", resource) when { context.payment_amount_cents > {{max_tx_cents}} };

parameters.name: max_tx_cents
parameters.description: $500.00 default cap. Adjust per agent role.

policy_templates.description: Allow charges only to vendors in your verified-recipients list. Defeats AI agents being tricked into paying attacker-controlled accounts.
policy_templates.cedar_template: permit(principal, action == Action::"payment.transaction.create", resource) when { context.payment_recipient in {{verified_recipients}} };

policy_templates.description: Require human-in-loop confirmation for any transaction above a threshold.
policy_templates.cedar_template: forbid(principal, action == Action::"payment.transaction.create", resource) when { context.payment_amount_cents > {{human_required_above_cents}} && context.human_present == false };

false_positives.scenario: A subscription billing agent legitimately runs charges every minute - R109 (rapid-fire) fires.
false_positives.remediation: Tag the agent with 'subscription-biller' and add applies_to_tags exclusion on R109. Don't disable globally.
